items: The app now speaks 16 more languages: French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Croatian, German, Chinese, Ukrainian, Esperanto, Swahili, Hindi, Bengali, Indonesian, Urdu, Farsi and Arabic. Pick one under the font picker in Settings. They are machine translated from English and have not been checked by a person.
Dates and numbers now follow your language and region.

New colour themes, the same 15 as the other apps from this maker (Settings > Appearance). System, the default, follows your device's light or dark mode. If you had picked a theme before, you get the closest new one.

AI ride reviews: connect a cowork folder from History and an AI coach grades each ride A–F, with strengths, fixes and what to ride next. You review each grade before it's kept. It sits beside the app's own numbers, and you can undo it.
While Google Drive sync is on, your Google picture now sits at the top of the app on every screen, so you can always see which account is syncing. Tap it to open the sync settings.
Coach replies now wait for your review before they replace the current advice, and you can undo them.
Settings has a button that erases all of this app's data on this device. Your Google Drive copy is not touched.
The app starts in a light or dark theme to match your device, until you pick one.
Atkinson Hyperlegible is now the default font, and you can change it in Settings.
Structured workouts: built-in sessions, .zwo import, an FTP ramp test and a 20-minute test.
Smart trainers are controlled directly: ERG mode follows workout targets, and Sim mode feels the gradient.
Power zones, categorised climbs with a live climb readout, auto-pause, and recovery of rides cut short by a crash.
Export any ride as a TCX file for Strava or Garmin.
Ride sounds, plus rain, snow, fog and night-ride skies.
